The '''Ogoth Tiir system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Atravis sector/Legends|Atravis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ogoth Tiir/Legends|Ogoth Tiir]].
